title: prompt_waiting
description: An agent stopped on a permission prompt and is waiting for an answer nobody gives (the companion saw Claude Code's notification). Written by the loop's companion. Not a stage and not progress. The companion never retries the write, so count one per event_id.

life.description: Which life of the issue the prompt came in; null when unknown.

seq.description: The record's sequence in this life; null when unknown.

step.description: The step the agent was running, for example build; null when unknown.

attempt.description: The attempt of that step; null when unknown.

agent_id.description: The agent's id; null when the prompt came from no sub-agent.

agent_type.description: The agent's type, for example Explore or general-purpose; null when unknown.

tool_name.description: Always null: the notification names no tool.

tool_input.description: The notification's message, which says what the agent waits for; not clipped; null when unknown.

slot.description: The writer's slot (worktree path) the prompt came from; null when unknown.

session.description: The Claude Code session id; null when unknown.

transcript.description: The path of the session's transcript; null when unknown.

branch.description: The issue's branch; null when unknown.

pr.description: The issue's PR number; null when it has none yet.

examples.tool_input: Claude needs your permission to use Bash
